Manifest.Name: 俯视射击小游戏框架 / Top-down Minigame Framework
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: 为原游戏额外运行俯视角射击小游戏的轻量框架。提供API v1物品、武器、地图、皮肤和PNG扩展；内置最小示例，准备界面可切换第三方地图。仅主菜单运行，无真实背包或存档结算，不依赖枪械模组。A lightweight top-down minigame framework with versioned content registration and sprite skins. Main-menu sandbox only; no real save or inventory integration.
